# OracleRegistry
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/rwa-oracles/src/OracleRegistry.sol)

**Inherits:**
Ownable, [IOracleRegistry](./interfaces/i-oracle-registry.md)

**Title:**
OracleRegistry

**Author:**
Summer

Central registry mapping ticker symbols and asset addresses to their corresponding RWA oracles.

Enables discovery of oracles by ticker (e.g. "SPXUX") or by asset token address.
The owner manages all mappings. Supports reverse lookups for integration with consumers.


## State Variables
### tickerToOracle
Ticker symbol => oracle address


```solidity
mapping(string => address) public tickerToOracle
```


### assetToOracle
Asset token address => oracle address


```solidity
mapping(address => address) public assetToOracle
```


### oracleToTicker
Oracle address => ticker symbol (reverse lookup)


```solidity
mapping(address => string) public oracleToTicker
```


### oracleToAsset
Oracle address => asset token address (reverse lookup)


```solidity
mapping(address => address) public oracleToAsset
```


## Functions
### constructor


```solidity
constructor(address _owner) Ownable(_owner);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_owner`|`address`|Address that will own the registry and manage oracle mappings|


### setOracle

Register or update an oracle for a given ticker and asset.

Reverts with InvalidTicker, InvalidAsset, or InvalidOracle if any input is invalid.
Overwrites any existing mapping for the same ticker or asset.


```solidity
function setOracle(string calldata ticker, address asset, address oracle) external onlyOwner;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ticker`|`string`|Ticker symbol (e.g. "SPXUX"). Must be non-empty.|
|`asset`|`address`|Address of the underlying asset token this oracle prices.|
|`oracle`|`address`|Address of the RwaOracle contract providing price feed.|


### getOracleByTicker

Get the oracle address for a ticker symbol.


```solidity
function getOracleByTicker(string calldata ticker) external view returns (address);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ticker`|`string`|Ticker symbol to look up.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|Address of the oracle, or zero address if not registered.|


### getOracleByAsset

Get the oracle address for an asset token.


```solidity
function getOracleByAsset(address asset) external view returns (address);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`asset`|`address`|Address of the asset token to look up.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|Address of the oracle, or zero address if not registered.|
